post_meta.title: Pinchot 6/7
post_meta.text: Pinchot 6/7. Long snow approach from both sides, moderate angle, boot pack is in. Spikes only. The descent to Woods Creek is postholing misery after 10am. Woods Creek ford was the scariest thing I have done on trail, waist deep, moving hard, we linked arms. Go at dawn or wait.
